profile.name: Velkazar
profile.title: Hellspawn Torturer
profile.characteristics: Enemies hit by the [Scorching Heat] is knocked back into the [Zone of Inferno]. [Zone of Inferno] deals great DMG and weakens your DEF, so fast escape is crucial. When [Executioner's Casket] is summoned, focus fire to destroy the casket, which will deal great DMG to Velkazar, and will cancel out [Hellfire].

1.name: Sword of Punishment
1.description: Strikes the ground with the sword of Velkazar, dealing M.DMG and summoning flaming balls of fire from the sky that inflicts stun to enemies for 4 sec and reduces their heal rate by 10 sec.

2.name: Scorching Heat
2.description: Deals M.DMG to all enemies with the power of heat, knocking them back into the Zone of Inferno and inflicting knockdown for 6 sec. This effect cannot be resisted.

3.name: Roar of the Executioner
3.description: Emits a roar that deals M.DMG to nearby enemies and inflicts Knockback. Additionally creates blazing fire around self for 15 sec, dealing M.DMG to nearby enemies per each sec and reducing their Mana.

4.name: Hellfire
4.description:
After every third Skill that Velkazar casts, it summons the Executioner's Casket that lasts for 20 sec, then casts Hellfire.
Velkazar belches out a breath of fire, dealing M.DMG to all frontal enemies for 15 sec. DMG increases each sec.

5.name: Flesh of Inferno
5.description: Velkazar is immune to ATK Spd effects. If Velkazar takes DMG 400 times, it summons flaming balls of fire from the sky that deals M.DMG and inflicts stun.

6.name: Zone of Inferno
6.description: The blazing Zone of Inferno deals great M.DMG every sec and decreases enemies' DEF.

7.name: Executioner's Casket
7.description:
The Executioner's Casket is not affected by DEF effects, and inflicts a permanent wound to nearby enemies every 10 sec, reducing their Heal Rate and increasing DMG they take. Velkazar takes some of DMG dealt to the Executioner's Casket instead.
HP of the Executioner's Casket increases each time it's summoned. If it is destroyed before it disappears by itself, Velkazar takes massive DMG and becomes neutralized for a certain time.
While neutralized, Velkazar summons an Executioner's Casket with infinite HP.
